find src test tests -type f 2>/dev/null | sort | head -160; printf '\n--- matches ---\n'; grep -RInE "mouseout|focusout|delayShow|activeAnchor|active.*anchor|anchor" src --exclude='*.css' | head -240

sed -n '1,640p' src/components/Tooltip/use-tooltip-events.tsx; printf '

'; sed -n '1,340p' src/components/Tooltip/Tooltip.tsx; printf '

'; grep -RInE "delayShow|same.*id|multiple|anchor.*content|mouseout|focusout|switch" src/test/tooltip-*.spec.js | head -240

git status --short; sed -n '1,540p' src/test/tooltip-close-and-delay-behavior.spec.js; printf '
--- attribute/content tests ---
'; sed -n '1,140p' src/test/tooltip-attributes.spec.js; printf '

'; sed -n '1,290p' src/components/TooltipController/TooltipController.tsx; printf '

git show --stat --oneline e730508 && git show --format=fuller --no-ext-diff e730508 -- src/components/Tooltip/use-tooltip-events.tsx src/components/Tooltip/Tooltip.tsx; printf '\n--- prior anchor-switch commit ---\n'; git show --format=fuller --no-ext-diff 00b296f -- src/components/Tooltip/use-tooltip-events.tsx src/components/Tooltip/Tooltip.tsx
git remote -v; git branch -a --no-color | head -30; git log --all --oneline --decorate -20; sed -n '390,560p' src/components/Tooltip/Tooltip.tsx
git diff --check && git diff -- src/components/Tooltip/Tooltip.tsx src/components/Tooltip/use-tooltip-events.tsx && npx jest src/test/tooltip-close-and-delay-behavior.spec.js --runInBand

sed -n '1,240p' src/test/tooltip-imperative.spec.js; sed -n '560,690p' src/components/Tooltip/Tooltip.tsx; git diff --numstat; git diff --check; tail -c 20 src/components/Tooltip/Tooltip.tsx | od -An -t x1; tail -c 20 src/components/Tooltip/use-tooltip-events.tsx | od -An -t x1

git show e730508 -- src/test/tooltip-attributes.spec.js; git log --oneline --all -- src/test/tooltip-imperative.spec.js | head -15; git blame -L 635,645 src/components/Tooltip/Tooltip.tsx
